meta.coordinate_system: origin at bottom-left of the map; +x to the right, +y upward
meta.gate_rule: node entry cost. Walking from u to v costs edge_weight + gate_cost(v). Neither endpoint of a route is charged: the origin is never entered, and the destination is exempt because a route ends there instead of passing through it. So a route costs (sum of its edge weights) + (gate_cost of every gate strictly inside it). Every gate_cost in this file is already the effective value.

adjacency_note: weight = walking distance. enter_cost = gate_cost of the node you arrive at. cost = weight + enter_cost, the cost of that one step. Neither endpoint of a route is charged, so when you relax the step that lands on the destination, do not add its enter_cost (equivalently: sum cost over the whole route, then subtract the last step's enter_cost).
